featured_reviews.name: ANAND SALIYAN
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5-Star Review for Praanvi’s 5th Birthday Celebration

We recently celebrated my daughter Praanvi’s 5th birthday, and the entire event was wonderfully managed by Mumbaikar Moments Events & Entertainment. Their work on the decoration, magic show, and anchoring truly made the day special.

✨ Decoration:
The décor was vibrant, creative, and perfectly designed for a 5-year-old’s birthday theme. From the entrance to the stage backdrop, every detail was thoughtfully arranged. The colourful setup added so much joy to the atmosphere, and the kids loved it.

🎩 Magic Show:
The magic show was a big hit! The magician was engaging, funny, and kept all the children glued to their seats. The tricks were entertaining and interactive—Praanvi especially enjoyed being part of the show!

🎤 Anchoring:
The anchor from Mumbaikar Moments did a fantastic job keeping the event lively and well-coordinated. The games, activities, and interaction with the kids were perfectly timed and full of energy. All the children had a great time.

Overall, Mumbaikar Moments Events & Entertainment made Praanvi’s birthday truly memorable. We received so many compliments from our guests, and we’re extremely happy with how the event turned out.
Highly recommended for any celebration!

name: Wedding Raga by GPS
description:
With 13+ years of expertise, Wedding RaGa by GPS (formerly GPS Photography Lounge) is dedicated to crafting timeless wedding stories for discerning couples.

Founded by Gayatri Shah in Mumbai, we specialize in capturing the rich tapestry of Indian weddings—blending tradition, emotion, and elegance into every frame. Our culturally intuitive and bespoke approach ensures your love story is documented with authenticity and artistry, no matter the scale or setting.

Backed by a passionate, handpicked team, we deliver a seamless, luxury photography experience—from the first meeting to the final curated album—designed to preserve your most meaningful moments for a lifetime.

Loved the photos, videos and movie. Highly recommend booking them for your big day.
